       AND bt.pbet_busentity_type = ml.pbet_busentity_type
       AND bt.epl1_busent_log_lvl1_code = ml.epl1_busent_log_lvl1_code
       AND ml.plng_langcode = '@Session(languageCode)'

    ON dst.porg_orgacode = BT.porg_orgacode

    ON dstm.porg_orgacode = dst.porg_orgacode AND dstm.pdst_dsr_type = dst.pdst_dsr_type AND
       dstm.plng_langcode = '@Session(languageCode)'

snd_pr_prd_product prd
         LEFT JOIN snd_pr_prd_product_m prdm
                   ON prd.porg_orgacode = prdm.porg_orgacode AND prd.porp_princode = prdm.porp_princode AND
                      prd.pprd_prodcode = prdm.pprd_prodcode AND prdm.plng_langcode = '@Session(languageCode)'
                left join snd_pr_prd_product_m prdms
                           on prd.porg_orgacode = prdms.porg_orgacode and prd.porp_princode = prdms.porp_princode and
                              prd.pprd_prodcode = prdms.pprd_prodcode and prdms.plng_langcode = '@Session(languageCodeSecondary)'
         INNER JOIN glb_pr_orp_principal prin
                    ON prd.porg_orgacode = prin.porg_orgacode AND prd.porp_princode = prin.porp_princode
         LEFT JOIN glb_pr_orp_principal_m prinm
                   ON prin.porg_orgacode = prinm.porg_orgacode AND prin.porp_princode = prinm.porp_princode AND
                      prinm.plng_langcode = '@Session(languageCode)'
         LEFT JOIN snd_pr_pty_prod_type prdtyp
                   ON prd.porg_orgacode = prdtyp.porg_orgacode AND prd.ppty_prod_type = prdtyp.ppty_prod_type
         LEFT JOIN snd_pr_pty_prod_type_m prdtypm ON prdtyp.porg_orgacode = prdtypm.porg_orgacode AND
                                                     prdtyp.ppty_prod_type = prdtypm.ppty_prod_type AND
                                                     prdtypm.plng_langcode = '@Session(languageCode)'
         LEFT JOIN (SELECT ppa1.ppa1_prod_analysis,
                           coalesce(ppa1m.ppa1_desc, ppa1.ppa1_desc) level9_desc,
                           ppa1.porg_orgacode
                    FROM SND_PR_PA1_PROD_ANALYSIS_1 ppa1
                             LEFT JOIN snd_pr_pa1_prod_analysis_1_m ppa1m
                                       ON ppa1.porg_orgacode = ppa1m.porg_orgacode AND
                                          ppa1.ppa1_prod_analysis = ppa1m.ppa1_prod_analysis AND
                                          ppa1m.plng_langcode = '@Session(languageCode)'
                    where ppa1.ppa1_level_no = 9
                      and ppa1.ppa1_leveltype = 'D'
                      AND ppa1.ppa1_active IN ('A', 'Y')) ppa13
                   ON prd.porg_orgacode = ppa13.porg_orgacode AND prd.ppa1_prod_analysis = ppa13.ppa1_prod_analysis
         LEFT JOIN (select CTG.ppa1_prod_analysis, coalesce(CTGM.ppa1_desc, CTG.ppa1_desc) ppa1_desc, CTG.porg_orgacode
                    from snd_pr_pa1_prod_analysis_1 CTG
                             LEFT JOIN snd_pr_pa1_prod_analysis_1_m CTGM ON CTG.PORG_ORGACODE = CTGM.PORG_ORGACODE and
                                                                            CTG.PPA1_PROD_ANALYSIS = CTGM.PPA1_PROD_ANALYSIS AND
                                                                            CTGM.plng_langcode = '@Session(languageCode)'
                    where CTG.ppa1_level_no = 3
                      and CTG.ppa1_leveltype = 'G'
                      AND CTG.ppa1_active IN ('A', 'Y')) ctg ON prd.porg_orgacode = CTG.porg_orgacode AND
                                                                prd.ppa1_prod_analysis like concat(CTG.ppa1_prod_analysis, '%')
         LEFT JOIN (select BRND.ppa1_prod_analysis,
                           coalesce(BRNDM.ppa1_desc, BRND.ppa1_desc) ppa1_desc,
                           BRND.porg_orgacode
                    FROM snd_pr_pa1_prod_analysis_1 BRND
                             LEFT JOIN snd_pr_pa1_prod_analysis_1_m BRNDM
                                       ON BRND.PORG_ORGACODE = BRNDM.PORG_ORGACODE and
                                          BRND.PPA1_PROD_ANALYSIS = BRNDM.PPA1_PROD_ANALYSIS AND
                                          BRNDM.plng_langcode = '@Session(languageCode)'
                    where BRND.ppa1_level_no = 5
                      and BRND.ppa1_leveltype = 'G'
                      and BRND.ppa1_active in ('A', 'Y')) BRND ON prd.porg_orgacode = BRND.porg_orgacode AND
                                                                  prd.ppa1_prod_analysis like concat(BRND.ppa1_prod_analysis, '%')

result.tbl:
(SELECT
prd.porg_orgacode AS TXT__PORG_ORGACODE,
prd.porp_princode AS Principle,
prd.pprd_prodcode AS Product_ID,
COALESCE(DIVISIONM.PPA1_DESC, DIVISION.PPA1_DESC) AS DISVISION,
COALESCE(SUBDIVISIONM.PPA1_DESC, SUBDIVISION.PPA1_DESC) AS SUB_DIVISION,
coalesce(CTGM.ppa1_desc, CTG.ppa1_desc) AS Category,
COALESCE(SCTGM.PPA1_DESC, SCTG.PPA1_DESC) AS SUB_Category,
coalesce(BRNDM.ppa1_desc, BRND.ppa1_desc) AS Brand,
COALESCE(SECTORM.PPA1_DESC, SECTOR.PPA1_DESC) AS Sector,
COALESCE(CPGM.PPA1_DESC, CPG.PPA1_DESC) AS CPG,
COALESCE(SUBBRANDM.PPA1_DESC, SUBBRAND.PPA1_DESC) AS SUB_Brand,
ppa13.level9_desc AS Base_Pack,
prd.modified_date AS modified_date

FROM
snd_pr_prd_product prd
  LEFT JOIN snd_pr_prd_product_m prdm
    ON prd.porg_orgacode = prdm.porg_orgacode
       AND prd.porp_princode = prdm.porp_princode
       AND prd.pprd_prodcode = prdm.pprd_prodcode
       AND prdm.plng_langcode = '@Session(languageCode)'
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT
               ppa1.ppa1_prod_analysis,
               coalesce(ppa1m.ppa1_desc, ppa1.ppa1_desc) level9_desc,
               ppa1.porg_orgacode
             FROM SND_PR_PA1_PROD_ANALYSIS_1 ppa1
               LEFT JOIN snd_pr_pa1_prod_analysis_1_m ppa1m
                 ON ppa1.porg_orgacode = ppa1m.porg_orgacode
                    AND ppa1.ppa1_prod_analysis = ppa1m.ppa1_prod_analysis
                    AND ppa1m.plng_langcode = '@Session(languageCode)'
                    where ppa1.ppa1_level_no = 9) ppa13
  ON prd.porg_orgacode = ppa13.porg_orgacode
      AND prd.ppa1_prod_analysis = ppa13.ppa1_prod_analysis

    LEFT JOIN snd_pr_pa1_prod_analysis_1 CTG
                   ON CTG.porg_orgacode = prd.porg_orgacode
                       AND CTG.ppa1_prod_analysis = Left(prd.ppa1_prod_analysis,Length(CTG.ppa1_prod_analysis))
                       AND CTG.ppa1_active IN ('A', 'Y')
                       AND CTG.ppa1_level_no = 3
         LEFT JOIN snd_pr_pa1_prod_analysis_1_m CTGM
                   ON CTG.PPA1_PROD_ANALYSIS = CTGM.PPA1_PROD_ANALYSIS AND CTG.PORG_ORGACODE = CTGM.PORG_ORGACODE
                       AND CTGM.plng_langcode = '@Session(languageCode)'

         LEFT JOIN snd_pr_pa1_prod_analysis_1 BRND
                   ON BRND.porg_orgacode = prd.porg_orgacode
                       AND BRND.ppa1_prod_analysis = Left(prd.ppa1_prod_analysis,Length(BRND.ppa1_prod_analysis))
                       AND BRND.ppa1_active IN ('A', 'Y')
                       AND BRND.ppa1_level_no = 5
             LEFT JOIN snd_pr_pa1_prod_analysis_1_m BRNDM
                   ON BRND.PPA1_PROD_ANALYSIS = BRNDM.PPA1_PROD_ANALYSIS AND BRND.PORG_ORGACODE = BRNDM.PORG_ORGACODE
                       AND BRNDM.plng_langcode = '@Session(languageCode)'

         LEFT JOIN snd_pr_pa1_prod_analysis_1 DIVISION
                   ON DIVISION.porg_orgacode = prd.porg_orgacode
                       AND DIVISION.ppa1_prod_analysis = Left(prd.ppa1_prod_analysis,Length(DIVISION.ppa1_prod_analysis))
                       AND DIVISION.ppa1_active IN ('A', 'Y')
                       AND DIVISION.ppa1_level_no = 1
             LEFT JOIN snd_pr_pa1_prod_analysis_1_m DIVISIONM
                   ON DIVISION.PPA1_PROD_ANALYSIS = DIVISIONM.PPA1_PROD_ANALYSIS
                          AND DIVISION.PORG_ORGACODE = DIVISIONM.PORG_ORGACODE
                       AND DIVISIONM.plng_langcode = '@Session(languageCode)'
         LEFT JOIN snd_pr_pa1_prod_analysis_1 SUBDIVISION
                   ON SUBDIVISION.porg_orgacode = prd.porg_orgacode
                       AND SUBDIVISION.ppa1_prod_analysis = Left(prd.ppa1_prod_analysis,Length(SUBDIVISION.ppa1_prod_analysis))
                       AND SUBDIVISION.ppa1_active IN ('A', 'Y')
                       AND SUBDIVISION.ppa1_level_no = 2
             LEFT JOIN snd_pr_pa1_prod_analysis_1_m SUBDIVISIONM
                   ON SUBDIVISION.PPA1_PROD_ANALYSIS = SUBDIVISIONM.PPA1_PROD_ANALYSIS
                          AND SUBDIVISION.PORG_ORGACODE = SUBDIVISIONM.PORG_ORGACODE
                       AND SUBDIVISIONM.plng_langcode = '@Session(languageCode)'
         LEFT JOIN snd_pr_pa1_prod_analysis_1 SCTG
                   ON SCTG.porg_orgacode = prd.porg_orgacode
                       AND SCTG.ppa1_prod_analysis = Left(prd.ppa1_prod_analysis,Length(SCTG.ppa1_prod_analysis))
                       AND SCTG.ppa1_active IN ('A', 'Y')
                       AND SCTG.ppa1_level_no = 4
             LEFT JOIN snd_pr_pa1_prod_analysis_1_m SCTGM
                   ON SCTG.PPA1_PROD_ANALYSIS = SCTGM.PPA1_PROD_ANALYSIS
                          AND SCTG.PORG_ORGACODE = SCTGM.PORG_ORGACODE
                       AND SCTGM.plng_langcode = '@Session(languageCode)'
         LEFT JOIN snd_pr_pa1_prod_analysis_1 SECTOR
                   ON SECTOR.porg_orgacode = prd.porg_orgacode
                       AND SECTOR.ppa1_prod_analysis = Left(prd.ppa1_prod_analysis,Length(SECTOR.ppa1_prod_analysis))
                       AND SECTOR.ppa1_active IN ('A', 'Y')
                       AND SECTOR.ppa1_level_no = 6
             LEFT JOIN snd_pr_pa1_prod_analysis_1_m SECTORM
                   ON SECTOR.PPA1_PROD_ANALYSIS = SECTORM.PPA1_PROD_ANALYSIS
                          AND SECTOR.PORG_ORGACODE = SECTORM.PORG_ORGACODE
                       AND SECTORM.plng_langcode = '@Session(languageCode)'
         LEFT JOIN snd_pr_pa1_prod_analysis_1 CPG
                   ON CPG.porg_orgacode = prd.porg_orgacode
                       AND CPG.ppa1_prod_analysis = Left(prd.ppa1_prod_analysis,Length(CPG.ppa1_prod_analysis))
                       AND CPG.ppa1_active IN ('A', 'Y')
                       AND CPG.ppa1_level_no = 7
             LEFT JOIN snd_pr_pa1_prod_analysis_1_m CPGM
                   ON CPG.PPA1_PROD_ANALYSIS = CPGM.PPA1_PROD_ANALYSIS
                          AND CPG.PORG_ORGACODE = CPGM.PORG_ORGACODE
                       AND CPGM.plng_langcode = '@Session(languageCode)'
         LEFT JOIN snd_pr_pa1_prod_analysis_1 SUBBRAND
                   ON SUBBRAND.porg_orgacode = prd.porg_orgacode
                       AND SUBBRAND.ppa1_prod_analysis = Left(prd.ppa1_prod_analysis,Length(SUBBRAND.ppa1_prod_analysis))
                       AND SUBBRAND.ppa1_active IN ('A', 'Y')
                       AND SUBBRAND.ppa1_level_no = 8
             LEFT JOIN snd_pr_pa1_prod_analysis_1_m SUBBRANDM
                   ON SUBBRAND.PPA1_PROD_ANALYSIS = SUBBRANDM.PPA1_PROD_ANALYSIS
                          AND SUBBRAND.PORG_ORGACODE = SUBBRANDM.PORG_ORGACODE
                       AND SUBBRANDM.plng_langcode = '@Session(languageCode)') PRD
